summary: What was filed: BMO Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC, as depositor for BMO 2023-5C2 Mortgage Trust, filed an 8-K disclosing a succession of the special servicer under a pooling and servicing agreement. Who acted: C-IV Asset Management LLC succeeded Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer, effective September 1, 2026, for the servicing of two mortgage loans held by the issuing entity. Exact terms: none disclosed (no price, premium, or value) — assignment and assumption agreement attached as Exhibit 20.1. Board recommendation/advisor: none. Mechanics: standard servicing succession for two CMBS loans (11 West 42nd Street and Short Pump Town Center) under BANK5 2023-5YR3 PSA; no structural change to the issuing entity. To watch: no material transaction — routine servicer transition, no risk-arb angle.
